title: Ethiopian Pumpkin Stew
community: All of Ethiopia — the pumpkin fasting stew
author: Mama Tigist
desc: Ethiopian Pumpkin Stew — pumpkin chunks simmered in a berbere and tomato sauce. The pumpkin absorbs the berbere deeply and partially dissolves, creating a thick, rich sauce of surprising complexity. An underappreciated Ethiopian fasting gem.
longDesc: Ethiopian pumpkin stew is the fasting platter's sweet note — the pumpkin's natural sweetness balancing the heat of the berbere in a combination that surprises with its depth.
steps: Add garlic and berbere. Fry 2 minutes.
chefTips: Pumpkin dissolves partially — the dissolved portions thicken the sauce beautifully.
Orange-fleshed pumpkin for maximum beta-carotene and colour.
commonMistakes: Over-cooking to complete mush — some whole pieces are better.
cookingScience: Pumpkin's high beta-carotene content makes it the most vibrant orange vegetable in Ethiopian cooking. The dissolved pumpkin starch thickens the berbere sauce, which then turns a vivid orange-red — one of the most visually striking Ethiopian dishes.
culturalNote: Ethiopian pumpkin stew is the harvest season's gift to the fasting platter — the sweetness of pumpkin and the heat of berbere in a combination that captures the spirit of abundance even in the strictest fasting period.
